description: This file contains implementation of core file and directory handling classes, including File, Directory, and Partition, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods to load file info and manage file handle.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation and normalization.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a disk partition with methods to load partition info and read partition name.

methods.name: LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes directory paths to a consistent format.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: RemoveRepeatedPathSeparator
methods.description: Removes duplicate path separators from a path string.

methods.name: ReadPartitionName
methods.description: Reads the device name associated with a partition.

methods.name: LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads information about the partition, such as size and free space.
